programs.title: Riding School
programs.short: Structured lessons from first steps to advanced competition.
programs.body: A structured path for every rider — beginners build balance, safety and confidence, while experienced riders refine position, aids and feel. Lessons are matched to your level and to a horse that suits you.
programs.points:
Private & group lessons
Matched horse for your level
Kids & adults

programs.title: Show Jumping
programs.short: Precision, rhythm and courage over fences.
programs.body: Gridwork, course riding and competition preparation, coached by trainers with international show experience. Build the precision, agility and connection with your horse that clear rounds are made of.
programs.points:
Gridwork & course riding
Competition preparation
Video feedback

programs.title: Dressage
programs.body: Develop suppleness, rhythm and a quiet, effective seat. From basic school figures to lateral work, dressage lessons sharpen communication between horse and rider.
programs.points:
Flatwork foundations
Lateral work
Test riding

programs.title: Theoretical Classes
programs.short: Horsemanship knowledge that supports every ride.
programs.body: Short, focused classes on horse care, behaviour, anatomy, tack and riding theory — complementing practical training with a deeper understanding of horsemanship.
programs.points:
Horse care & anatomy
Tack & equipment
Riding theory

programs.title: Young Horse Training
programs.short: A calm, solid foundation for future athletes.
programs.body: Groundwork, starting under saddle and responsiveness training for young horses — patient, consistent work that builds a confident and willing partner.
programs.points:
Groundwork
Starting under saddle
Progress reports

programs.title: Horse Leasing
programs.short: Ride a talented horse without the full commitment.
programs.body: Lease one of our well-schooled horses for regular riding and training — a great step between lessons and ownership.
programs.points:
Full or part lease
Includes care & stabling
Coach support

programs.title: Events & Parties
programs.body: A unique venue for birthdays, corporate gatherings and celebrations — with pony rides, arena demos and catering from our café.
programs.points:
Pony rides
Arena demos
Catering available

programs.title: Restaurant & Café
programs.body: Relax with coffee, fresh drinks and snacks — indoor and outdoor seating with a view over the arena. No riding required.
programs.points:
Indoor & outdoor seating
Arena view
Family friendly
